fields.statement: Verifier claude-code (opus) at da28284e: read the diff; CLAUDE.md gains a '## Bug requests' section naming `rhiza request --kind bug`, the CLI/Request app/orchestrator/watchdog, `.rhiza/dispatch.toml`, plan-bug and bugfix, says both are autonomous with no owner step whatever rhiza.autonomy.* says, and that bugs never come from GitHub issues. Matches .rhiza/dispatch.toml ([request] bug=plan-bug, [ready] bug=bugfix) and `autonomous = true` in both workflow files. With a scratch build of this commit (RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset): `rhiza request --help` exit 0 and lists --kind feature|bug|milestone; `rhiza workflow describe plan-bug` and `rhiza workflow describe bugfix` exit 0 from this checkout's .rhiza/workflows, all autonomy auto; `rhiza workflow check plan-bug`/`bugfix` are valid with the bypassed-permissions warnings the note calls expected.
